title: Get a licence to trade or run a stall in a public place
what: Get the council's licence before selling goods or services from a stall, or otherwise trading, in a street, on council property or in another public place.

laws.title: Town of Port Hedland Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2016

sources.title: Town of Port Hedland Public Places and Local Government Property Local Law 2016
sources.locator: cl 11.1, as made, Gazette No. 61, 13 Apr 2016
sources.quote: A person must not sell food in or on any thoroughfare or local government property except under and in accordance with a food sales licence authorising the sale of food at that thoroughfare or local government property.
